It really helps me polish the game and make Frankie’s adventure better for everyone.[/p][p]Tom - PyroPeak Studios[/p]

notes.title: 🚒 Firefighter Frankie - Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thanks for playing Firefighter Frankie! 🐾 I’ve been working on fixes and small improvements since launch:

[list]
[*] 🐱 Adjusted cat placement so they can be collected correctly
[*] 🔥 New Endless Mode after finishing the story (Fires keep reigniting)
[*] 🚒 Fixed utility pole, refinery, pumpjack, and airplane fires
[*] 🎮 Clearer Molotov mission
[*] 🌍 Better collisions, navigation, and translations
[/list]

More polish and updates are coming, thanks for your support and feedback!

Tom - PyroPeak Studios

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]I'm excited to announce that the game will launch on [b]September 19, 2025 – 16:00 CEST (07:00 PDT)[/b]! [/p][p]The full release will start with a [b]20% launch discount[/b]. The base price is [b]$1.99 USD[/b] (regional prices will be shown automatically in your local currency on Steam).
[/p][p]Thank you for all your support! I can’t wait to see you on launch day!

Tom - PyroPeak Studios[/p]
